DepthValue

The depth value used to draw 2D objects to the screen. Starts at -1f and increments to 1f for each osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable which draws a opaque interior through osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode.DrawOpaqueInterior(osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IRenderer).

ShaderStorageBufferObjectStack<TData>

A wrapper around osu.Framework.Graphics.Rendering.IShaderStorageBufferObject`1 providing push/pop semantics for writing an arbitrary amount of data to an unbounded set of shader storage buffer objects.
